comment.body:
Mission plotted. Start with #The Route, then the eight level cards left-to-right (each ends in a boss battle), then #Colorado Rulebook, #The 30-Minute Recipe and #Final Boss: The Drive Test. #Skill Tree shows what unlocks what. The #Mission Log sheet has one cell per session for 20 weeks — react ✅ on a cell when it's logged.

Judgment calls: 40 hrs ÷ 2 hrs/week = 20 weeks, so the plan starts Mon Sep 14 and ends Jan 31; snow lands in Level 6 (December) on purpose. Highway waits until Level 5, after lane changes and gap choice are solid. The 20 🌙 sessions cover Colorado's 10 night hours exactly.

Two things only you know: when Josh's permit was issued (12-month hold gates the test date) and whether the 6 hrs with a driving school are done. The odometer on #The Route has a ?? for the permit — tell me and I'll fill it in. The whole thing is a slide deck too: arrows in full screen.

Built on a local daemon: isocan.io refused this sandbox's connections (egress policy, HTTP 403), so the canvas could not be born at the hosted home. The whole canvas — history, blobs, this thread — is exported to scratch/josh-drives-me on branch claude/josh-driving-plan-jve2oj; `isocan import scratch/josh-drives-me --to https://isocan.io` restores it there intact.
